summary: Plan 06 P7 is delivered with a CP08-prep0 base-test bridge, a CP08-prep canonical-V3 expand checkpoint and a CP08 contract checkpoint: prep0 first makes base-owned manifest and tools tests valid across the transition; prep then switches IFX callers and ownership to canonical V3 while compatibility copies still exist; CP08 parameterizes the Stage Gate, generates only outside the repository, removes the tracked generated tree and duplicate implementations, and retains only declared public wrappers.
rationale: The trusted-base candidate verifier overlays every base-owned test from the base into the candidate. The old manifest suite requires the legacy runner to remain byte-identical and uses an existing legacy setup script as its untrusted-workflow negative control; the old tools suite compares generated bytes with a tracked snapshot whose checkout line endings vary by platform. Those assertions cannot validate the intended wrapper and canonical-tool transition, so CP08-prep0 first changes only the tests: it uses a genuinely missing executable for the negative control, stops treating the public runner as a fork copy, and proves analysis reproducibility across two isolated runs without rewriting authored snapshots. CP08-prep then changes ownership and callers; CP08 performs the deletions. Generation roots remain outside head and base, identifier collisions fail closed, required-check names and ruleset remain unchanged, and all protected changes use exact-candidate authorization. This refines D1, D3, D6, D9 and D14.
